scientific_question: Does the single fixed H1-Tikhonov multiplier 0.03, selected only from the already opened t=0.5 development result, satisfy the frozen five-, seven-, and nine-camera reference-adequacy gate at four other normalized model times?
role: post-open private controlled-proxy temporal transfer diagnostic; not real experimental pairing, not a learned method, and not a deployment result

new_source_semantics.density_output: first TorchScript output is the density field
new_source_semantics.time_input: t is normalized to the closed interval [0, 1]
new_source_semantics.synthetic_pairing: camera-field pairing and two-component projected observations may be generated by code for the virtual dataset; no true experiment pairing is inferred
new_source_semantics.source: direct clarification from the supervising senior on 2026-08-18

inputs.models: the same nine CPU-adapted TorchScript models sealed by v157/v158
inputs.calibrations: the same thirteen nine-camera JSON files sealed by v157/v158
inputs.model_calibration_pairing: complete 9 x 13 cross-product generated as a controlled proxy; never infer a true experimental match
inputs.time_disclosure: all five time points had source-only finite/variation summaries in the earlier model-family audit, but only t=0.5 had inverse-problem metrics before this protocol

representation.field_subspace: zero-mean DCT 16x8x8 excluding the constant coefficient
representation.penalty: physical-axis Neumann H1 spectral eigenvalue normalized to median one
representation.geometry_scale: median generalized normal eigenvalue above max-eigenvalue times 1e-12

arms.excluded_alternative: lambda 0.1 is not evaluated and cannot replace the primary

regularization.origin: post-hoc diagnostic at opened t=0.5 in v158, frozen here before any non-t=0.5 inverse score

metrics: p50/p90-higher/worst by time, arm, and camera count

cost_accounting.geometry_setup: 1023 exact nine-camera A-equivalent basis projections per calibration; camera subsets and all times reuse sealed geometry
cost_accounting.primary_online_after_geometry_cache: one exact reduced A-transpose equivalent for B^T y and one exact reduced A equivalent for the projection
cost_accounting.resource_claim: forbidden until a later fresh-process wall and whole-pipeline RSS gate

independent_recomputation.physics: rebuild camera rays and sparse operators with the independent v156 numerical path
independent_recomputation.basis: analytic cosine products rather than scipy idctn basis construction

decision_order: Any input, source-semantics, operator, basis, penalty, density, stationarity, residual, accounting, or independent-recomputation failure makes v159 inconclusive.
Only fixed multiplier 0.03 is the primary; no alternative lambda may replace it after results.
The primary passes only if every one of the twelve time-by-camera strata passes all absolute gates and each nine-camera stratum satisfies the parent no-harm checks.
A valid failure closes fixed-lambda temporal transfer for this controlled proxy and does not authorize a larger model or GPU rescue.

A valid pass establishes only within-family temporal reference adequacy and authorizes a separately frozen minimal CPU predictor diagnostic; it is not real BOST, external generalization, or a resource result.
